=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:220-285 (hold branch; GH_PAT writes at lines 270 and 277; job predicate lines 24-27; route-trust check lines 796-798) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The label_missing hold in "Resolve integration ref" posts a comment and adds ai:blocked with GH_PAT before the "Decide clarify route" trust check, so an untrusted /reclarify comment with the pr-dependency-released shape can trigger the writes.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: sonnet and minimax rated it NIT, luna rated it MAJOR, so the highest (major) is used. Sonnet noted the impact is small because the writes are idempotent and the comment is deduplicated.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:997-1030 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The release block deletes the shared ai:blocked label when a hold marker exists, including an ai:blocked added by another gate (for example implement.yml:6155-6157). It also acts on a stale ISSUE_META_FILE snapshot, so a concurrent add between the snapshot and the delete is removed too.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: sonnet rated the race NIT (confidence 2), while the others rated it MAJOR, so the highest (major) is used. The delete can unblock an issue that should stay blocked.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:993-1030 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The release and marker rewrite run only when ai:blocked is currently on the issue (and when "Fetch issue comments" ran). After a manual label removal the open marker stays, so a later unrelated ai:blocked matches it and is deleted by the next /reclarify.
  WHY: The one-shot invariant depends on ai:blocked being present at every relevant /reclarify.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:262-270 (also 265-266) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The hold comment offers "add the canonical tracking line" as a fix without saying it only works on ai:orchestrator-managed issues (scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:214).
  WHY: Severity disagreement: minimax rated it MAJOR, the others NIT, so the highest (major) is used. Following the advice on a non-managed issue yields label_missing again, and marker dedup posts no new explanation.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:1018-1029 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: If the marker PATCH to released succeeds but the ai:blocked DELETE fails, the marker is already retired, so later /reclarify runs cannot release the label.
  WHY: The issue stays blocked with no release path until an operator clears it by hand.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:if-gating after "Resolve integration ref" | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The label_missing_hold gating on later steps is complete and enforced by a test, so there is no concrete failure; the only cross-boundary item is the untrusted-trigger issue above.
  WHY: Reported as a NIT with no concrete failure.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The plan should record that script's path and the evidence and file it as a separate follow-up, not stall this PR."
  expected_change_site: A separate follow-up issue referenced from the PR or changelog
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The changelog names scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (execute_stall_recovery_action) and says the fix is "left to a follow-up issue", but no follow-up issue number or link appears in the PR description, PR comments or diff. Severity: MAJOR per gemini, minimax and qwen; NIT per sonnet and luna; the highest (MAJOR) applies.
- requirement: "The fix must remove the cause and ship a regression test that reproduces the failing condition ... Record in the PR that you ran it both ways."
  expected_change_site: PR description
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The tests exist in tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py, but the PR body does not say they were run against both the reported head and the fix. Severity: NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:"Resolve integration ref" label_missing hold branch (job predicate lines 26-27) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The hold writes a comment and ai:blocked with GH_PAT before the route trust check, so an untrusted pr-dependency-released-shaped /reclarify can trigger the writes.
  WHY: Impact is small: the target must already be in the label_missing shape, and the hold comment is deduplicated.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:~997-1030 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The release and marker rewrite run only when ai:blocked is currently present and "Fetch issue comments" ran.
  WHY: After a manual label removal the open marker stays, and a later unrelated ai:blocked would be deleted by the next /reclarify.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:~262-270; changelog.d/7516-clarify-label-missing-hold.md | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The tracking-line fix is valid only with ai:orchestrator-managed (scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh:214), but the hold comment does not state that condition.
  WHY: An operator following the advice on a non-managed issue gets label_missing again with no new comment.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:release block (DELETE of ai:blocked after the marker PATCH) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: A writer can add ai:blocked between the ISSUE_META_FILE snapshot and the delete.
  WHY: The window is seconds long and the next /reclarify is the human path for correcting it.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:if gating after refctx | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Gating is complete and test-enforced; no concrete failure.
  WHY: The only cross-boundary item is the untrusted-trigger NIT above.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The plan should record that script's path and the evidence and file it as a separate follow-up, not stall this PR." (AD-3)
  Expected change site: A separate follow-up issue referenced from the PR or changelog.
  Evidence of absence: The changelog says the fix is "left to a follow-up issue" and no issue number appears in the diff or PR comments. This is a documentation gap, not a code defect.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Record in the PR that you ran it both ways"
  Expected change site: PR description.
  Evidence of absence: The tests exist but the PR body does not say they were run both ways.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/clarify.yml hold branch: the two gh api -X POST calls are not retried (suggest a two-attempt loop, about 6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
